item.title: DefectDojo Pro Installation Guide
item.description: Covers deployment on AWS EKS and OpenShift (ROSA). The workflow is the same for both: set up infrastructure, create secrets, install the chart.

item.title: DefectDojo Pro Upgrade Guide
item.description: Covers upgrading an existing DefectDojo Pro release to a newer chart version. The recommended path is to pull the chart directly from the DefectDojo OCI registry — no zip extraction required. The packaged-zip workflow used at install time also works for upgrades and is documented below.

item.title: Deploying DefectDojo Pro on OpenShift
item.description:
DefectDojo Pro runs on OpenShift 4.x, including OpenShift Container Platform, ROSA, and OKD.

This page is a supplement to the installation guide supplied with your DefectDojo Pro license. That guide has the full procedure, including a dedicated OpenShift section. This page covers what is different about OpenShift, so you know what to have ready before you start and what to expect from the platform-specific settings.

item.title: Kubernetes Migration Runbook & Troubleshooting
item.description: This is the detailed runbook for migrating an open source DefectDojo to self-hosted Pro on Kubernetes: the dry run and the cutover, a troubleshooting index keyed on the exact error text (search this page for the message you see), and a post-migration verification checklist. It is a companion to the general Migrating from Open Source to Self-Hosted DefectDojo Pro overview, which covers the data-movement concepts that apply to either deployment method.

item.title: Upload Size Limits for Large Scan Files
item.description: A large scan file can be rejected by more than one limit, at different points in the request path, and the error you get tells you which one you hit. This page covers where those limits are and how to raise them on a Kubernetes deployment. Running Docker Compose? See Upload Size Limits (Docker Compose).
